name: Witch
summary: The spellcasting path: walks by day, brews at the Magic Cauldron and climbs from Novice to Scarce.
blood: None. Witches use a Magic meter instead.

abilities.name: Fists
abilities.effect: Your hand glows purple and throws magic orbs at medium range.

abilities.name: Soul Drain
abilities.effect: Lift the target and drain its soul for heavy damage, healing you by the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.effect: Vanish and move faster. You can still be hit.

abilities.name: Break Neck
abilities.effect: Levitate the target, then break its neck.

abilities.name: Heart Extraction
abilities.effect: Rip out a [[heart]]. Eating it grants one extra life against a lethal attack.

abilities.name: Pain Infliction
abilities.effect: Torment the target. Run out of mana while using it and you start taking damage.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.effect: Lift, carry and hurl another player from a distance.

abilities.name: Push
abilities.effect: Pushes several players at once. [TBC] unlock level.

clan.name: Coven
clan.body: Witches form covens: the witch's answer to bloodlines and packs.

weaknesses: Spells can backfire at high levels (a skill check against stronger foes)

sections.heading: Supreme Witch
sections.body: The highest-level witch on a server holds the **Supreme Witch** title: +10% magic damage, +10% Strength potency and duration, and +10% petrification duration, with no extra mana cost.

sections.heading: Casting
sections.body: Spells need five [[candle|candles]] from the [[witch-shop]]. Crafting is done at the Magic Cauldron in the [[witch-house]]. The [[grimoire]] is how you join, not how you cast.

disputed: The name of the 800+ rank, *Scarce*, is unconfirmed.
notes: A *Powerful Witch* game pass appears on the old Trello: see [[powerful-witch-pass]].
